tokens.name: color-base
tokens.usage: Page ground everywhere outside a game hub: deep night navy. Code: --color-base.

tokens.name: color-elevated
tokens.usage: Panels, menus, inputs, the store bar and the order summary. Code: --color-elevated.

tokens.name: color-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered and selected rows, booths, received chat bubbles. Code: --color-raised.

tokens.name: color-stage
tokens.usage: The photo stage behind card photos in the carousel and the listing gallery.

tokens.name: color-well
tokens.usage: The card well: the 63:88 box every card photo sits in. Wells are never skinned.

tokens.name: color-well-line
tokens.usage: Border of color-well.

tokens.name: color-avatar
tokens.usage: Avatar fill, thumbnail borders, the stepper track and the switch track.

tokens.name: color-chrome
tokens.usage: Phone tab bar, the ticker band and sticky phone action bars.

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Default hairline: header, panel and table borders. Code: --color-line.

tokens.name: color-line-hv
tokens.usage: Ghost button and input borders. Code: --color-line-hv.

tokens.name: color-line-strong
tokens.usage: Checkbox and radio rings, the hovered ghost button border.

tokens.name: color-hover-wash
tokens.usage: Ghost button and row hover fill.

tokens.name: color-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets, and the Sold veil on a card well.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every ground in every theme (17:1 on color-base). Code: --color-ink.

tokens.name: color-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text that stays bright: venues, plain chips, booth labels.

tokens.name: color-ink-dim
tokens.usage: Body copy and meta on color-base, color-elevated and color-raised (8.1:1 on color-base). Code: --color-ink-dim.

tokens.name: color-ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps and placeholders (5.5:1 on color-base, 4.6:1 on color-raised). Code: --color-ink-faint.

tokens.name: color-ink-ghost
tokens.usage: Inactive carousel bars, the sheet grabber, empty stars. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The one action colour, holo cyan: primary buttons, focus rings, unread dots, the Sell tab. Code today: --color-gold, renamed --color-accent in P2.

tokens.name: color-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on color-accent (11.5:1).

tokens.name: color-accent-wash
tokens.usage: Atlas speaking for itself: the announcement bar and the sell band.

tokens.name: color-accent-line
tokens.usage: Border of color-accent-wash surfaces.

tokens.name: color-foil-1
tokens.usage: Holographic foil, first stop. Foil appears only in the card tilt sweep and the carousel progress bar.

tokens.name: color-foil-2
tokens.usage: Holographic foil, second stop.

tokens.name: color-foil-3
tokens.usage: Holographic foil, third stop.

tokens.name: color-foil-4
tokens.usage: Holographic foil, fourth stop.

tokens.name: color-confirmed
tokens.usage: Positive status: NM condition, prices up, paid and released steps, verified shields, under-market deals. Code: --color-confirmed.

tokens.name: color-confirmed-line
tokens.usage: NM chip and deal block border.

tokens.name: color-confirmed-wash
tokens.usage: Deal block fill.

tokens.name: color-fixed
tokens.usage: Information: LP condition, info notices, your own location on a map. Code: --color-fixed.

tokens.name: color-fixed-line
tokens.usage: LP chip and info notice border.

tokens.name: color-warn
tokens.usage: Time pressure and caution: MP condition, ending soon, event pins, caution notices. Code: --color-warn.

tokens.name: color-warn-line
tokens.usage: MP chip, ending-soon chip and caution notice border.

tokens.name: color-urgent
tokens.usage: Losses and problems: prices down, HP condition, errors, outbid, disputes. Code: --color-urgent.

tokens.name: color-urgent-line
tokens.usage: HP chip, invalid input and danger button border.

tokens.name: color-graded
tokens.usage: Graded slabs and star ratings. Never an action.

tokens.name: color-graded-line
tokens.usage: Graded chip border.

tokens.name: color-graded-wash
tokens.usage: Graded chip fill.

tokens.name: color-plain-line
tokens.usage: Plain chip border: event types, languages, seller types.

tokens.name: color-map-land
tokens.usage: Map ground. Choose the P8 tile style to sit close to the map tokens.

tokens.name: color-map-road
tokens.usage: Map roads.

tokens.name: color-map-water
tokens.usage: Map water.

tokens.name: color-map-park
tokens.usage: Map parks.

tokens.name: color-map-label
tokens.usage: Map labels (5.2:1 on color-map-land).

tokens.name: skin-ground
tokens.usage: Page ground of a game hub. Outside hubs it equals color-base.

tokens.name: skin-surface
tokens.usage: Panels, search fields, set tiles and event rows on a skinned page. Outside hubs: color-elevated.

tokens.name: skin-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered and selected rows, ticket stubs on a skinned page. Outside hubs: color-raised.

tokens.name: skin-control
tokens.usage: The game picker inside a search field.

tokens.name: skin-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on a skinned page.

tokens.name: skin-line-strong
tokens.usage: Ghost buttons, inputs and filter chips on a skinned page.

tokens.name: skin-border
tokens.usage: Accent-tinted border of game doors, the hub hero and eyebrow pills.

tokens.name: skin-accent
tokens.usage: The game's identity colour: active tabs, sub-navigation, chart lines, door names. Never a button fill. Outside hubs it is color-ink. Text 4.5:1 or better on skin-ground in every theme.

tokens.name: skin-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on skin-accent (selected segmented control).

tokens.name: skin-text
tokens.usage: Secondary text on skin-ground: subtitles, counts, inactive tabs (6:1 or better on skin-ground).

tokens.name: skin-faint
tokens.usage: Captions and placeholders on skin-ground (4.5:1 or better on skin-ground and skin-surface).

styles.name: t-stub

styles.name: t-mono

styles.name: t-mono-lg
styles.usage: The countdown on an auction page.
